closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, brings a clean fruit identity, and easy to use as a whole food, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low vitamin A. It is good for practical meals, immune support, and low-calorie volume because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, vitamin C and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
